title: Preparation and characterization of kaolin–[TMS]–NH2+C(NO2)3− as a novel heterogeneous nano-catalyst and its use in the synthesis of imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine and 1,2,4-triazolo[4,3-a]pyrimidines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26992-27015
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01292A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahla Dorostkar, Leyla Nazemi-Nasyrmahale, Farhad Shirini
This article presents a highly efficient and eco-friendly method for synthesizing imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidines and 1,2,4-triazolo[4,3-a]pyrimidines using a novel nano-catalyst, kaolin–[TMS]–NH2+C(NO2)3−, under solvent-free conditions.
